components.name: Magnetic Button
components.description: A button that leans toward the cursor with a distance-falloff pull, its label travelling a further fraction so the two arrive at different rates.

props.name: strength
props.description: Maximum travel toward the cursor in pixels, reached only at dead centre.

props.name: radius
props.description: Capture distance in pixels; outside it the button does not react at all.

props.name: labelFactor
props.description: Extra travel applied to the label on top of the button's own, as a fraction.

props.name: stiffness
props.description: Spring stiffness for both the follow and the release.

props.name: damping
props.description: Spring damping; below about 25 the release visibly overshoots.

props.name: mass
props.description: Spring mass. Higher values feel heavier and arrive later.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual weight, from filled accent down to type only.

props.name: size
props.description: Height, horizontal padding and type size together.

components.name: Split Reveal
components.description: Text wiped into place from behind a per-piece mask on entering view, at character, word or authored-line granularity, with the full string kept as a single accessible label.

props.name: text
props.description: The string to reveal. Plain text, so it can be split without walking children.

props.name: split
props.description: What gets its own mask. Lines split on authored newlines, not measured wraps.

props.name: as
props.description: Root element, so the heading level matches the document outline.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds each piece takes to clear its mask.

props.name: stagger
props.description: Seconds between consecutive pieces starting.

props.name: delay
props.description: Seconds before the first piece moves.

props.name: distance
props.description: How far below the mask each piece starts, as a percentage of its own height.

props.name: threshold
props.description: Fraction of the element that must be visible before it starts.

props.name: repeat
props.description: Replay on every re-entry instead of only the first.

components.name: Mesh Gradient
components.description: Multi-point blended color field on canvas where each point orbits its own anchor on its own period, so the drift has no visible loop length and no discrete shape edges.

props.name: colors
props.description: Token names sampled for the blend points; three to five reads best.

props.name: points
props.description: Number of blend points. Above six the field turns to mud at any size.

props.name: speed
props.description: Drift rate. 0 draws one static frame and never schedules a loop.

props.name: blur
props.description: Blur radius as a fraction of 100px; this is what removes the circle edges.

props.name: grain
props.description: Opacity of the noise overlay that stops the blend banding. 0 removes it.

props.name: seed
props.description: Deterministic layout — the same seed always gives the same arrangement.

props.name: resolution
props.description: Backing store scale. 1 is sharp and costly; 0.6 is invisible behind the blur.

components.name: Spotlight Card
components.description: Pointer-tracked radial highlight inside the card with a masked border glow sharing the same origin, driven entirely through CSS custom properties so moving the pointer never re-renders.

props.name: size
props.description: Radius of the highlight in pixels; scale it with the card, not the page.

props.name: intensity
props.description: Peak opacity of the interior light. Above 0.2 it starts fighting body text.

props.name: borderIntensity
props.description: Peak opacity of the border glow. Set 0 for an interior-only light.

props.name: color
props.description: Token the light is made from.

props.name: fade
props.description: Seconds to fade in on enter and out on leave; forced to 0 under reduced motion.

components.name: Fade In
components.description: The generic in-view wrapper: fades and rises its content once on entering the viewport, adding no markup of its own, and with stagger set it sequences direct children by merging style onto them rather than wrapping them.

props.name: as
props.description: Root element. Use ul or ol when the children are list items.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds of the fade and rise.

props.name: delay
props.description: Seconds before it starts.

props.name: distance
props.description: Rise distance in pixels; negative values drop in from above instead.

props.name: threshold
props.description: Fraction of the element that must be visible before it fires.

props.name: rootMargin
props.description: Shifts the trigger line; a negative bottom margin fires later.

props.name: stagger
props.description: Seconds between direct children. 0 animates the wrapper as one block.

props.name: repeat
props.description: Replay on every re-entry instead of latching after the first.

components.name: Use In View
components.description: IntersectionObserver as a hook returning a ref and a boolean, defaulting to fire once and reporting true when the observer is unavailable so content is never stranded.

props.name: threshold
props.description: Fraction of the element that must be visible before it counts as in view.

props.name: rootMargin
props.description: CSS margin grown around the root bounds; negative values delay the trigger.

props.name: once
props.description: Disconnect after the first entry. Set false to have the boolean flip both ways.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Skip observing and report true at once — what reduced-motion branches pass in.

components.name: Class Merge
components.description: The class merge every component root uses: clsx flattens conditionals, then tailwind-merge resolves Tailwind conflicts per utility group so a caller className genuinely overrides rather than races.
